countryroads.stake.surveying: Surveying a path to the nearest road...
countryroads.stake.preview: Path to the road: %s blocks (%s through rock). Needs %s path material (dirt, gravel, sand, packed mud, cobblestone...), %s stone for the steps (cobblestone, stone, andesite, sandstone...), %s planks and %s torches. Right-click the stake to build it, break the stake to cancel.
countryroads.stake.missing: Not enough materials: %s more path material, %s more stone, %s more planks and %s more torches (your inventory and chests within 8 blocks count).
countryroads.stake.waypoint: Waypoint %s set: the path will pass here. Right-click the first stake to build, break a waypoint to remove it. (Sneak while placing a stake to start a separate path.)
countryroads.stake.built: This path is built. Break the stake to take it up again.
countryroads.stake.no_road: No road within %s blocks. Place the stake closer to a road (it must be loaded).
countryroads.stake.on_road: The stake is already on the road.
